approval: Delegated local technical decision under constitution revision 4.
decision: Extend the existing profiling tool with explicit additional label-column selection, test it offline, then re-dispatch local-dev-test-subject on the unchanged prefixes twice.
expected_outcome: Observed UWF label-candidate frequencies and repeatability, not detection accuracy or comparative improvement.
hypothesis: Explicitly selecting mitre_attack_tactics will yield repeatable categorical counts on the same authorized prefixes; empty or uninformative values would refute its usefulness for within-prefix discrimination.
observation: The exact subject's first probe found mitre_attack_tactics in every UWF CSV schema, but the query tool did not count it because the name heuristic excludes that field.
rationale: Source understanding should configure extraction tools; a missing heuristic match is not proof that ground-truth-like fields are absent.
